columns.name: PARTY_IMPORT_ERROR_ID
columns.description: Generated import error identifier associated with failure of the record.

columns.name: BATCH_NAME
columns.description: Batch Name to identify the set of records to be processed.

columns.name: STG_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: The staging table for which the error is flashed

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party Name used to identify the party

columns.name: PARTY_NAME
columns.description: Party Name used to identify the party

columns.name: PARTY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Party type code associated with the record such as THIRD_PARTY,etc.

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code of the error record.

columns.name: TAX_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Tax status code of the error record.

columns.name: TAX
columns.description: Stores the tax code of the error record.

columns.name: TAX_RATE_CODE
columns.description: Tax rate code of the error record.

columns.name: CONTENT_OWNER_NAME
columns.description: Content owner name of the error record.

columns.name: TAX_JURISDICTION_CODE
columns.description: Tax jurisdiction code of the error record.

columns.name: EXEMPT_CERTIFICATE_NUMBER
columns.description: Exemption certificate number of the error record.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Effective start date of the error record.

columns.name: REPORTING_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Reporting type code of the error record.

columns.name: REPORTING_CODE_CHAR_VALUE
columns.description: Alphanumeric type reporting code of the error record.

columns.name: REPORTING_CODE_DATE_VALUE
columns.description: Date type reporting code of the error record.

columns.name: REPORTING_CODE_NUM_VALUE
columns.description: Numeric type reporting code of the error record.

columns.name: TAX_PAYER_NUMBER
columns.description: Taxpayer number of the error record.

columns.name: MESSAGE_CAUSE
columns.description: Cause associated with the error condition.

columns.name: MESSAGE_USER_ACTION
columns.description: User action that can be performed for the error condition.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TEXT
columns.description: Message text to provide details about the error.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
